Messages.Author: Shankar
Messages.Body:
When a card like Supernatural Resistance is used to cancel a strike
card, does the opposing minion get to choose a new strike? I ask
because in the card text for Direct Intervention, it specifies that a
new strike is chosen. Relevant card texts:

Supernatural Resistance
Requires a Laibon with three or more Orun.
Tap an Orun on this Laibon to cancel an action card targeting this
Laibon or a strike card as it is played. Not usable to cancel a card
that doesn't require a Discipline or that requires Celerity [cel] or
Potence [pot] .

Direct Intervention
Master: out-of-turn.
Cancel a minion card as it is played. No cost is paid. (If it was an
action card, the acting minion doesn't tap. If it was a strike card,
the minion chooses another strike.)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Shankar wrote:
> When a card like Supernatural Resistance is used to cancel a strike
> card, does the opposing minion get to choose a new strike?

Yes. The minion is required to choose a strike.
